# Berkeley News

> UC Berkeley's central news hub covering faculty research, student programs, podcasts, and institutional announcements with daily coverage of scientific discoveries, arts, and campus life.

Berkeley News serves as the official news and information engine for UC Berkeley, featuring original reporting on research breakthroughs, faculty expertise, and student initiatives. The site provides multiple content formats including articles, podcasts (Berkeley Talks, Berkeley Voices, Berkeley Changemaker), and expert directories for media professionals.

## Key Topics

- UC Berkeley
- Berkeley Voices
- Berkeley Talks
- Faculty Research
- Scientific Discovery
- CRISPR

- Satellite Missions

## News & Archives

- [Berkeley News](https://news.berkeley.edu): UC Berkeley's main news and information engine with daily stories
- [All news - Berkeley News](https://news.berkeley.edu/all-news): Comprehensive archive of all UC Berkeley news articles and stories

## Podcasts & Audio Content

- [Podcasts - Berkeley News](https://news.berkeley.edu/podcasts): Directory of UC Berkeley podcasts including Berkeley Talks and Voices
- [Berkeley Talks - Berkeley News](https://news.berkeley.edu/podcasts/berkeley-talks): Podcast series featuring UC Berkeley faculty lectures and conversations
- [Berkeley Voices - Berkeley News](https://news.berkeley.edu/podcasts/berkeley-voices): Award-winning podcast showcasing UC Berkeley faculty research stories
- [Berkeley Changemaker - Berkeley News](https://news.berkeley.edu/topics/berkeley-changemaker): Podcast series profiling UC Berkeley students driving social impact

## Research & Science

- [Astronomers capture birth of a magnetar](https://news.berkeley.edu/2026/03/11/astronomers-capture-birth-of-a-magnetar-confirming-link-to-some-of-universes-brightest-exploding-stars): UC Berkeley astrophysics discovery on magnetar formation and supernovae
- [Berkeley's Blue and Gold satellites flying through Earth's magnetotail](https://news.berkeley.edu/2026/03/04/berkeleys-blue-and-gold-satellites-are-now-flying-through-earths-magnetotail-a-first): UC Berkeley ESCAPADE satellite mission exploring Earth's magnetosphere
- ['Reprogramming' our gut bacteria could be key to fighting disease](https://news.berkeley.edu/2026/03/05/reprogramming-our-gut-bacteria-could-be-key-to-fighting-disease): UC Berkeley CRISPR research on microbiome engineering for disease prevention
- [What do parasitic worms and wages have in common?](https://news.berkeley.edu/2026/03/05/berkeley-voices-s2e5-deworming): Berkeley Voices episode on deworming research and economic outcomes
- [Climate Change - Berkeley News](https://news.berkeley.edu/topics/climate-change): UC Berkeley climate research and sustainability science coverage

## Arts, Culture & Humanities

- [Psychedelic film series at BAMPFA opens doors to other worlds](https://news.berkeley.edu/2026/03/17/psychedelic-film-series-at-bampfa-opens-doors-to-other-worlds): BAMPFA film series on psychedelic cinema and experimental film
- [What makes HBO's 'The Pitt' feel so real? Two UC Berkeley alums](https://news.berkeley.edu/2026/03/12/what-makes-hbos-the-pitt-feel-so-real-two-uc-berkeley-alums-who-bring-the-show-to-life-explain): Profile of UC Berkeley alumni behind HBO's The Pitt drama series
- [How Emily Dickinson's musical poetry pushes us to live](https://news.berkeley.edu/2026/02/02/how-emily-dickinsons-musical-poetry-pushes-us-to-live-more-expansively): UC Berkeley faculty analysis of Emily Dickinson's poetry and music

## Policy & Social Impact

- ['The Diversity Principle': Tracking the long history](https://news.berkeley.edu/2026/03/06/the-diversity-principle-tracking-the-long-history-of-a-powerful-idea): Berkeley Law scholarship on the history and impact of diversity principle
- [UC Berkeley college access program serving 1,500 students cut](https://news.berkeley.edu/2025/11/03/uc-berkeley-college-access-program-serving-1500-students-cut-over-equity-reference): Coverage of federal funding cuts to UC Berkeley's TRIO programs
- [Democracy in Distress - Berkeley News](https://news.berkeley.edu/topics/democracy-in-distress): UC Berkeley political analysis on democracy and election coverage

## Media & Communications Resources

- [Find an expert - Berkeley News](https://news.berkeley.edu/experts): Expert directory for journalists seeking UC Berkeley faculty sources
- [News & media relations team - Berkeley News](https://news.berkeley.edu/about/news-media-relations): Contact directory for UC Berkeley media relations and communications
- [Media Training for Academics - Berkeley News](https://news.berkeley.edu/media-training): Online course for UC Berkeley faculty on media communications
